name: Campingplatz Demmelhof
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Demmelhof is situated in St. Johann in Tirol, right at the foot of the dramatic Wilder Kaiser massif. The area is renowned for alpine pastures and an extensive trail network. Amenities include generous pitches, contemporary sanitary facilities, and a wellness suite with pool and sauna. A restaurant serving Tyrolean cuisine is on site. Open year-round, the park caters to hikers, cyclists, and winter sports lovers with cross-country ski tracks right on the doorstep.
